authorization: D51 approved the AC audit repair only. D11, the CI set, the reviewer model, presets, the T8 feature and W1 remain pending.
principle: Unnecessary mechanisms were deleted from the current candidate rather than marked deferred. Only real future capabilities remain deferred. revision-09.json and all review snapshots are unchanged.
revised_artifact_sha256_note: Not computed: only Read/Write/Edit/Glob/Grep are allowed.

responses.change: The PR lookup is no longer treated as native idempotence. pr_ensure queries before the first create: 0 matches creates once, 1 match is adopted, more than 1 is Blocked. An unknown create followed by a readback that finds a matching PR is adopted; an unknown create followed by zero matches stays unknown and Blocked, with no second create. A delayed-create counterexample is added to h10.

The temporary merged-snapshot mechanism is deleted from the first slice. On a base change, the required Green and regression are rerun on the actual head H bound to the new base, and review is repeated. Any needed integration produces a new real head and all gates are rechecked. A merged snapshot is never labeled as Green at H, and h7 asserts this distinction.
locations: spec-delta.md §3 GAT-03 and the AC-G17 addition

responses.change: The first slice supports only GitHub Actions check-runs. The expected identity is app github-actions + workflow path .github/workflows/loopctl-ci.yml + job/check name. The latest attempt is chosen by run_id and then run_attempt, not started_at, so a queued attempt with no start time still counts as latest. Other workflows or apps are ignored. Unorderable or ambiguous candidates are unknown, with no fallback to an old success. Commit-status-only required checks are unknown (unsupported); no normalizer is designed. The specific check policy remains pending D11. h4 is extended with queued/no-start, same-app wrong-workflow, unorderable and commit-status cases.

`loopctl status --human` is removed as the T8 feature candidate: it is implemented and validated in T2.1/s5, so it is superseded and recorded only in this revision history. T8 must be a genuinely unimplemented bounded behavior chosen at D11. The author does not select one. The T8.0 handshake and success criteria are unchanged.

The per-test required-ID registry, the @owner marker, scripts/required-tests-check and cross-job junit accounting are deleted. The rule is now: the required CI jobs (unit-linux, unit-macos, static) run their suites and pass; platform-specific cases are selected with ordinary pytest platform conditions; a missing job, zero collected tests, or a skip not caused by a platform condition is a failure rejected in G1 evidence review. Build/install smoke and the required CI jobs remain. No replacement framework is added.
locations: tasks.md general rules, 1.1 owned paths and completion

responses.change: Mandatory per-sample user signatures are deleted. The authorized independent reviewer records the rubric results for W-A..W-F in the existing docs/validation/s1/proof.md. Only genuinely unresolved business or policy choices go to the existing human decision points (D11, acceptance). Plan approval and B1 acceptance/merge are unchanged.

Explicit Red eligibility is restored. The snapshot changes and the attempt commit range must be within the approved task scope, and the snapshot → attempt → current head lineage must hold. Each is judged independently; valid raw/provenance and a successful diagnostic replay cannot rescue either. g3b is added with an out-of-scope case and an unrelated-lineage case, both rejected even when replay succeeds.

deleted_mechanisms: temporary merged-snapshot Green for base changes
per-test required registry, @owner marker, required-tests-check script and cross-job accounting
